tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files available to you, with their size in lines.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description:
Read a file. ledger.beancount returns the complete ledger exactly as the
scorer sees it, with no line numbers; line endings are normalized to LF —
once per revision: a second complete read of a revision you already have
returns a short receipt instead of the file. The other files come in
numbered slices of up to 200 lines (offset/limit).

path.description: File name, as shown by list_files.
path.title: Path

offset.description: First line to return, zero-based. Ignored for ledger.beancount.
offset.title: Offset

limit.description: How many lines to return. Ignored for ledger.beancount.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search the files for a literal piece of text (not a regular expression).

pattern.description: The exact text to look for, case-sensitive.
pattern.title: Pattern

path.description: Limit the search to one file. Omit to search all of them.
path.title: Path

tools.name: run_beancount
tools.description: Read the current ledger through the boundary and report.

tools.name: write_ledger
tools.description: Write the full corrected ledger and check that it loads.

content.description: The complete ledger file. This replaces the existing one.
content.title: Content

tools.name: submit
tools.description:
End the episode. The ledger as last written is final.

Call this once you have written a ledger with write_ledger and it loaded.
Nothing is read or changed afterwards; the ledger on disk at this moment
is what is delivered, and its content hash is fixed here.

If nothing has been stored, or if the last write_ledger was refused by the
ledger protocol, submit is refused and the episode carries on.
